description: This Python source file defines Django view functions for the 'jwql' REST API, providing endpoints to retrieve proposals, filenames, preview images, and thumbnails based on instrument, proposal, or rootname. It imports data retrieval functions from a local module and exposes multiple API views for web requests.

methods.name: all_proposals
methods.description: Returns a JSON response with a list of all proposals.

methods.name: filenames_by_proposal
methods.description: Returns filenames for a specific proposal as JSON.

methods.name: filenames_by_rootname
methods.description: Returns filenames for a specific rootname as JSON.

methods.name: instrument_proposals
methods.description: Returns proposals associated with a given instrument as JSON.

methods.name: preview_images_by_instrument
methods.description: Returns preview images for an instrument as JSON.

methods.name: preview_images_by_proposal
methods.description: Returns preview images for a proposal as JSON.

methods.name: preview_images_by_rootname
methods.description: Returns preview images for a rootname as JSON.

methods.name: thumbnails_by_instrument
methods.description: Returns thumbnails for an instrument as JSON.

methods.name: thumbnails_by_proposal
methods.description: Returns thumbnails for a proposal as JSON.

methods.name: thumbnails_by_rootname
methods.description: Returns thumbnails for a rootname as JSON.
